text.「漆喰の家に住みたい」というご希望を叶えるため、リフォームを前提に物件探しから始: To answer a wish to live in a house of lime plaster, this couple began with the search for the apartment itself, renovation already in mind. What they found, after a long look, was a low-rise block in quiet residential streets, with a large cherry tree spreading outside the window. A full skeleton renovation let the plan be reconsidered from the beginning — the living room and the bedroom joined as a walk-through, a corner made for a study — and the layout built from scratch around the way they live. Walls and ceilings in every room are finished in lime plaster; the floors are natural materials, wool-linen carpet and solid timber. A home for unhurried hours: comfortable air, the cherry blossom in view, and the Scandinavian furniture they chose.
text.熟練職人が滑らかでいて、味のある風合いに仕上げています。調湿効果があるため結露し: Laid by a skilled plasterer, smooth and full of character. Because it regulates humidity it resists condensation, and it absorbs household smells, which makes for a comfortable room.
text.漆喰の白色と共に、反射したやさしい光が部屋中を包んでくれるため、あえて天井照明を: Because the soft reflected light, together with the white of the plaster, fills the whole room, no ceiling light was fitted; lamps are brought in where they are wanted.
